rows.text: builds a stack record of `rcx`, `rcx` and four zero qwords; when the word `dx` is `0x37`, `0x38` or `0x39` returns `0046AB10(rcx, 0x3E, record)`, `0046AB10(rcx, 0x40, record)` or `0046AB10(rcx, 0x42, record)` respectively, and for any other value returns 0

notes: 0046A790: the record address is the same in all three calls (r11-0x38 equals rsp+0x20 after the sub rsp, 0x58). The 'returns 0' path relies on eax being zeroed near the entry and not changed before the fall-through ret.
